channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: what the Microsoft feed shows and what to do
item.description: The Microsoft feed lists few entries, and most of them are updates to October's release rather than new fixes. The one item that needs planning is a .NET remote code execution flaw that Microsoft has not fixed yet. Identity Web and WSL need version checks if you use them.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
item.description: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday.

item.title: Microsoft: China’s Salt Typhoon hackers are using Artex
item.description: An AI tool implicated in several high-profile breaches is rapidly being integrated into the hacking suites of groups from China and North Korea, Microsoft said.

item.title: Hackers Exploit Unpatched Flaw in Defunct Idunno AntiCsrf Library
item.description: Attackers can exploit CVE-2026-131914 to achieve remote code execution via a single web request containing specially crafted data. The post Hackers Exploit Unpatched Flaw in Defunct Idunno AntiCsrf Library appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Threat actors could exploit them to leak or modify server information and to execute commands as root. The post SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties
item.description: An account tied to ShinyHunters announced the group’s return, as Okta spots possible links between Inception and ShinyHunters hackers. The post ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: CISA has added the vulnerability to its KEV catalog and instructed federal agencies to patch it within three days. The post Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic Scanner Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Hackers reportedly breached CIA intelligence analysis system
item.description: Unknown attackers have reportedly breached an open-source intelligence analysis system at the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA)

item.title: VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities
item.description: The critical bugs include an authentication bypass in vCenter and flaws that could allow code execution on ESX hosts. The post VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
item.description: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups.

item.title: Critical Apache Roller, Axis Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Attackers are targeting Confluence Data Center through an Axis flaw and Apache is warning of attacks against Roller. The post Critical Apache Roller, Axis Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
item.description: Swiss and Italian cybersecurity agencies are warning about automated cyberattacks powered by AI agents targeting organizations in the critical infrastructure sector.

item.title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million
item.description: Threat actors accessed databases containing customer information associated with clinics in Japan. The post SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. item.description: GreyNoise, WatchTowr and Cloudflare report probing and exploit attempts, while Cisco, Elastic, Red Hat and Siemens detail impact. The post Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
item.description: 1Password has disclosed a data breach after a an employee's corporate GitHub account was hacked and used to deploy malicious code to the company's backend services to steal customer data.

item.title: FIFA says hackers accessed ‘limited set of personal and business information’
item.description: The Switzerland-based international governing body for soccer says it's working with relevant authorities and law enforcement to investigate a recent breach.

item.title: Florida ransomware recovery CEO indicted for allegedly paying hacker ransoms
item.description: The CEO of a ransomware recovery firm was indicted by a federal grand jury over allegations he lied about his services and paid out ransoms to cybercriminals.

item.title: CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controllers used by food retailers to manage commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems.

item.title: Suspected ransomware attack disrupts cancer treatments, surgeries at Guadeloupe hospital
item.description: France’s national cybersecurity agency is investigating a suspected ransomware attack that impaired the computer systems of the University Hospital of Guadeloupe, forcing doctors to postpone surgeries, suspend some cancer treatments and revert to pen and paper.

item.title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
item.description: TL;DR More than 64% still valid after four years: GitGuardian’s State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 found that most valid secrets discovered in 2022 still worked in January 2026, because teams stall on what a revoke will break. Validity-only triage misses 46% of critical secrets: Prioritize by impact instead, weighing what a…

item.title: Microsoft fixes Microsoft 365 bug blocking access to Office apps
item.description: Earlier this week, Microsoft resolved a known issue that was preventing some Microsoft 365 customers from accessing Office applications.

item.title: Microsoft confirms authentication issues after November updates
item.description: Microsoft has confirmed that customers may experience authentication issues after installing November security updates that address a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach
item.description: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data.

item.title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys
item.description: Cybersecurity company Radware says attackers gained access to some of its customers' account details and cloud access keys through an unsecured internal Cloud WAF (Web Application Firewall) management API that was left exposed online.

item.title: Lawmakers warn ID verification companies to bolster security after September hack
item.description: A bicameral, bipartisan letter from lawmakers said identity verification companies still have significant security work to do in the wake of a data breach at IDscan in September.

item.title: CVE-2026-112732 Microsoft Office Visio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Information published. This CVE was addressed by updates that were released in November 2026, but the CVE was inadvertently omitted from the November 2026 Security Updates. This is an informational change only. Customers who have already installed the November 2026 updates do not need to take any further action.

item.title: European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation
item.description: Names and email addresses of EU Academy users were exposed in the AI-assisted cyberattack the European Commission detected in October. The post European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
item.description: McDonald's Japan, the fast-food giant's Japanese subsidiary, has disclosed a data breach after attackers accessed a database containing sensitive information for users of the company's official smartphone app.

item.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
item.description: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
